integrity: One proof-supported claim across the six report files, with a standalone symbolic checker; finite computation is not substituted for infinite-time asymptotic proof. Historical priority is provisional.
limitations: Autonomous four-compartment SIRCm at exact invasion threshold and finite nonnegative feedback; no off-threshold, infinite-feedback, or universal initial-value-independent constant H. Original 2006 zero-feedback paper not inspected in full; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
title: Universal critical relaxation and a feedback-controlled logarithmic correction in the SIRCm flow
